# G04 — Material graph / bevel / heat math

**Goal:** Research and prototype material evaluator: ceramic, paper, gel, brushed and relief. Build curvature-aware bevels, distance→height, gradients, color-space/alpha gates, shader WGSL samples and CPU math oracle. E05/E07/E14.

**Write-set exclusive:** `docs/agent-results/blobin-next-01/G04.md` and `experiments/blobin-next-01/G04/**`. The latter is an original private lab, **not blob.in production source**. Do not edit other workers, shared shader code, historical blob.in snapshot, Gnosix or the in.gnu6 engine.

**Gate:** define a minimal adversarial input and reproducible outcome. Record exact source+toolchain, dependency lock, viewport/DPR, hardware when relevant, verification results and a clear unsupported/NOT_RUN path. No invented benchmark or GPU proof. CPU compatibility and identity ownership must be addressed even for GPU-specific work.

**Handoff:** original committed lab code if implemented + one evidence report; declare candidate shared interfaces as proposals; integrator reconciles after all workers finish.
